nodes.summary: The dot of a chart item never passes the end of its production.
nodes.title: Earley item dot stays within its production

nodes.summary: The Earley recognizer accepts exactly the grammar's language.
nodes.title: Correctness of the Earley recognizer

nodes.summary: Acceptance by the Earley recognizer: some completed item for a production of the initial nonterminal consumes the whole input.
nodes.title: Acceptance by the Earley recognizer

nodes.summary: Completeness: if a chart item waits on a sentential form and that form yields a word fitting in the remaining input, the chart contains the item completed by that word.
nodes.title: Completeness of the Earley chart

nodes.summary: The chart as a predicate on `EarleyItem`s.
nodes.title: Earley chart as a predicate on items

nodes.summary: The Earley chart for input `w`: the least set of items closed under initialization, prediction, scanning, and completion.
nodes.title: Earley chart

nodes.summary: An Earley item: a production with a dot after `dot` symbols of its output, recognizing input that starts at the end of `pre` and whose recognized prefix is `consumed`. The full input is `pre ++ consumed ++ rest` for some `rest`.
nodes.title: Earley item

nodes.summary: Inversion of a yield from a single nonterminal: it begins with one production of that nonterminal.
nodes.title: A yield from one nonterminal starts with one of its productions

nodes.summary: Soundness: the recognized prefix of a chart item yields the input it consumed.
nodes.title: Soundness of the Earley chart

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
